newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Feb 20.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Thursday:

WASHINGTON - The federal government cleared the way for cities and towns to use 311 as a non-emergency telephone number at public safety agencies to divert less urgent calls from 911 operators who dispatch emergency assistance.
WASHINGTON - Some unwitting Internet surfers recently discovered that free smut on the global computer network isn't always free.
WASHINGTON - Consumer prices rose a scant 0.1 percent last month following four consecutive months of increases triple that size as both food and transportation costs fell.
WASHINGTON - Consumers are about to become high-tech gamblers, placing a bet on which of two largely incompatible types of modems they should buy.
